blind.description: A stylized compact stack of metal ingots or bars arranged in four tiers. The uppermost layer features three polished, warm copper- or bronze-colored ingots with rounded edges and small end-notches. The lower tiers consist of darker, weathered and oxidized bars in a cross-stacked arrangement. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and stylized with no floating parts or broken geometry.
blind.from_above: Three rectangular ingots arranged side-by-side in parallel, filling a squarish rectangular perimeter with warm copper surfaces and slight notch indentations along the outer edges.
blind.height_vs_figure: Reaches about shin-to-knee height on the 5 ft 9 in figure (approximately 1.5 feet tall) and roughly 1.5 to 2 feet wide.
